headline: Mexico's Central Bank Cuts Interest Rate to 6.25%
summary: Banxico lowered its benchmark interest rate from 6.5% to 6.25% to stimulate the economy. The bank raised its fourth-quarter headline inflation forecast from 3.5% to 3.7% but expects recent cooling trends to persist.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions are the primary tool for managing inflation and economic growth, directly influencing borrowing costs and currency valuation.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Lower interest rates reduce the cost of borrowing for businesses and consumers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lower interest rates typically reduce the yield on local currency assets, often leading to currency depreciation and changes in equity market valuations.
